01 · Purchasing intelligence

Make pre-purchase decisions more consistent.

A structured decision-support workflow for evaluating deal economics before purchase execution.

Problem

Purchase decisions depended on multiple inputs: buying cost, selling price, margin target, supplier support, and competitor evidence.

My role

Designed the business logic, KPIs, decision states, priority rules, and the operating workflow — implemented with AI-assisted development tools.

Decision output

Buy / Conditional / Hold / Review, with reason, best buying source, market context, and supplier priorities.

Commercial focus

Net effective cost, margin, discounts, deal terms, pricing position, and negotiation opportunities.

Impact

Created a repeatable framework for explaining why a purchase should proceed, require negotiation, be held, or be reviewed.

03 · Planning

Protect promo inventory without over-controlling stock.

A daily planning workflow for deciding how much stock to expose while keeping campaigns supplied through their end date.

Inputs

Current stock, warehouse, offer end date, selected promo SKUs, and run-rate history.

Run-rate logic

7-day default, with fallback to 15, 30, then 90 days when needed.

Core logic

Expected Demand = Run Rate × Remaining Days. Safety Stock is refreshed from current stock every day.

Protection rule

Calculated safety stock of 10 cases or less is set to zero to avoid protecting commercially insignificant quantities.

Output

SKU-level review of stock cases, run-rate source, days left, expected demand, allowed-today quantity, safety stock, and status — plus final upload and review files.

Cairo / GizaDaily refreshPromo planningUpload-ready XLSX

Anonymized / illustrative data — brands, barcodes, and SKUs are demo values.

04 · Master data

Replace repetitive catalog maintenance with batch workflows.

A small suite of tools for product creation, data mapping, issue validation, and bulk catalog changes.

Odoo mass upload

Barcode input + latest system export → Odoo-ready product sheet with Brand, Category, and ETA mappings.

Validation

Preview and issue reporting for missing barcodes, missing IDs, and incomplete mappings before upload.

Bulk catalog updates

Status, Classification, and Visibility changes can be applied to filtered SKUs or from a separate changes file.

Export

Export changed rows only or the full updated catalog, depending on the operational need.

Impact

Moved SKU setup from roughly 30 minutes per 10 SKUs to large product batches completed in minutes, reducing repetitive entry and error exposure.

~30m / 10 SKUs → batchesOdoo-readyMapping tablesIssue reports
